facts.value: Fighter-owned CommandInfo supplies cursor and timer. Interpreter paths set frame_count from cur_anim_frame+x898_unk and subtract frame_speed_mul only from non-sentinel timers. Each due opcode first reaches Command_Execute; unhandled opcodes index a handler table or the skip-length table after subtracting 10. Handlers decode command-union fields, write fighter/collision records or call external subsystems, and advance the cursor.
facts.rationale: Replace a broad single-resolver description with all three canonical paths and explicit sentinel, timing and alternate-dispatch behavior. Do not infer shared word size or downstream game policy from aliases.

Handlers mutate fighter gameplay or presentation state and advance the command cursor.

facts.value: Each interpreter updates frame_count even for a null cursor. A non-null stream decrements timer only when it differs from F32_MAX. Loops stop for null cursor, positive timer, or the sentinel/frame-boundary conditions. Normal and alternate loops call their respective handler table for unhandled opcodes; the third loop advances by stored lengths instead. The alternate loop clears throw_flags on entry and after an instruction changes timer to a nonpositive value.
